context: Marks the native buffer wrapper as Send + Sync so it can be moved into a spawned task, and adds a slice accessor.
explanation: FfiBuffer wraps a raw *mut c_void with no internal synchronization, and nothing here guarantees the underlying native allocator or buffer is thread-safe. Blanket unsafe impl Send/Sync is a promise to the compiler that this type can be freely shared and sent across threads; with as_slice() readable from one thread while another thread drops the buffer (freeing the native memory), this opens the door to data races and use-after-free that the type system can no longer catch.
